name: AMAT adaptive group rotation challenger
first_stage_universe: Identical eleven instruments to v13; retain native symbol and cluster caps
pipeline: Completed-session data and native quality gates
Select economic groups by robust trailing benchmark-relative performance
Rank eligible members by persistent group-adjusted momentum
Existing covariance estimation, volatility targeting and concentration caps
Separate causal slow regime and fast risk reduction with recovery hysteresis
Versioned target weights and unchanged authorization boundary
Shared execution-policy replay before considering activation

constraints.risk_monitoring: Every completed session; reductions cannot wait for normal group refresh
constraints.benchmark: QQQ with SPY secondary; references, not automatic risk-parity mandates
constraints.weekly_availability: Only fully completed exchange weeks; no partial-week label leakage
constraints.vix: Unavailable in current snapshot; no implicit substitution or fabricated VIX. Any realized-volatility variant is a separate named arm.
constraints.fallback: Cash when no eligible exposure; no automatic purchase of failed-trend benchmarks

causality: missing group member and benchmark abstention
robustness: risk-matched controls fitted on development only
evaluation.historical_scope: Existing historical research and 2026 observations are previously examined evidence, not a fresh holdout
evaluation.prospective_scope: Freeze implementation and parameters before collecting any prospective results
